description: Maintain your contributions to a moving-leader leaderboard as an ordered stack of idempotent patches (stack/NN-slug/) that rebase onto whatever submission currently leads, with a background leader watcher, a restack that scores the leader first, and a submission gate tied to the live board (submit only when the stack beats the leader by a written margin at submission time). Use on any benchmark where rivals keep landing rows while you build.
